title: Create the admin on first run
acceptance:
Story: the operator double-clicks the launcher on a fresh machine and receives an admin credential without a command line.
Expected: when the store has no accounts, startup creates one admin, prints a one-time key in the console as a single JSON line, and never prints it again.
Not expected: an admin creation screen, repeated first-run keys or command-line user creation; members arrive by invitation only.
Depends on: the WI-10 store and its accounts table.
Verify: acceptance captures the first-run key, signs in with it, and confirms a restart prints nothing new.
evidence: First run with zero accounts creates the admin and prints one JSON admin-created line with the one-time key; restart prints no second line (node test and verify.py). PR #6: https://github.com/chakibelbassam/FoundationOS/pull/6.
